summary: Recognize an exact Official Response heading as an RFI response while keeping similarly named metadata and suggested answers neutral.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Autodesk and Procore official documentation identifies Official Response as an RFI field
Ponytail review rejected a cross-vendor lifecycle status engine because the provider taxonomies differ
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only an exact heading boundary is recognized; free prose and OCR-corrupted labels remain neutral.
Provider lifecycle statuses remain source text because Autodesk and Procore use different taxonomies.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer document, mailbox or paid provider was used.
